items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I only seemed to work with Buddy when he was looking for a baritone player.

ctx.x: I didn’t work with Buddy all the time. I only seemed to work with Buddy when he was looking for a baritone player. But I would never do that, I would never go out with Buddy’s band. Buddy was too strict for me. I couldn’t deal with that.
He was a task master, to put it nicely.
